title: Native mode - ClassCastException: org.jboss.threads.JBossThread cannot be cast to java.lang.Thread
body:
java.lang.ClassCastException on app shutdown with websocket

Quarkus: 0.14.0
GraalVM: 1.0.0-rc-15
Application: https://github.com/burrsutter/quarkusfingerpaint ++ Quarkus version update

Error is not thrown each time, best way for me was to open 2 tabs with http://127.0.0.1:8080/ URL, do some drawing and shutdown the app.
